title: Growtics: Privacy Web Analytics & AI Growth Agent

What exactly does Growtics track?

Page views, visitor sessions, traffic sources, and on-site behaviour — combined with AI growth suggestions, an SEO & AEO score, and uptime monitoring, all in one board. No cookie banners required for the core analytics.

How is this different from Google Analytics?

Growtics isn't trying to be a bigger version of GA. It's a smaller, calmer board that combines analytics, session replays, SEO checks, AI growth actions, and monitoring in one place — built for indie builders, not enterprise marketing teams.

What are "AI growth actions"?

Growtics looks at your traffic patterns and site health, then turns them into specific next steps — like which page is leaking visitors, what to fix for conversions, or where performance is slowing people down — ranked by likely impact.

Do you support API and MCP access?

Yes. The Growth plan includes a REST API and an MCP server, so you can pull your site's data directly into Claude or other tools and ask questions about your traffic in plain language.

Is my visitors' data private?

Growtics is privacy-first by design. We collect the minimum needed to show you useful trends, never sell visitor data to third parties, and aim to keep things straightforward for GDPR compliance.

Can I switch plans or cancel anytime?

Yes — billing is monthly with no long-term contracts. Upgrade, downgrade, or cancel whenever you need to, directly from your account settings.

Do you offer a money-back guarantee?

Yes, we offer a 15-day money back guarantee on all our Pro plans. If you are not satisfied with Growtics within the first 15 days of your subscription, simply contact us for a full refund, no questions asked.
